h1: Seagrove Beach "It's All About the Views" 15 Chivas Lane 410A
description_expanded: HOME HIGHLIGHTS:- Amazing gulf views from large balcony- Private beach access- Renovated in 2024- Located in Dunes of Seagrove- Access to two community pools, tennis courts, pickle ball, sauna, fitness center, BBQ area, steam room- Covered parking- Elevator- EV Charger- Access to a large wraparound balcony from all rooms- 360 degree beachfront view from the 4th floor- Complete Clean Linen Participant - All linens, including comforter covers, are laundered upon every checkoutDETAILS: Escape to It's All About the Views in Seagrove Beach. Sleeping 6 and boasting 3 bedrooms and 3 bathrooms, this top-floor condo in the Dunes of Seagrove offers access to 2 resort-style pools, tennis courts, a sauna, and a private beach and boardwalk! Guests will love relaxing on the shaded wraparound balcony that overlooks the Gulf.Mesmerizing views of the gleaming Gulf provide a brilliant canvas for this modern coastal condo’s living, dining, and kitchen areas. Sparkling tile floors, beach-inspired accents, and a soft sectional create a stunning living area for guests to gather. The contemporary kitchen is stylishly designed with a waterfall island that seats 2 and high-end appliances, making preparing an evening feast or morning brunch a delightful experience. With 2 benches and 2 chairs, there’s plenty of space for the group to dine at the sleek wood dining table. Multiple glass doors allow guests to move freely onto the oversized balcony to drink in the resplendent view, bask in the gentle breeze, or dine alfresco at the table for 6. Feel free to pack light with the convenient laundry room. As night rolls in, retire to the primary bedroom with a king bed or the 2 guest bedrooms—the first has 2 twins and the second a king bed. All the bedrooms feature private bathrooms and balcony access.Panoramic views and resort-style amenities make It's All About the Views a perfect setting to unwind in Seagrove Beach. Exploring the Emerald Coast’s towns and attractions is easy with on-site parking. Private beach access is a quick walk away—simply follow the boardwalk. Book this charming condo today!SLEEPING ARRANGEMENTS: (SLEEPS 6):- Primary Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower and Tub- Guest Bedroom: Two Twin Beds, Private Bathroom with Shower - Guest Bedroom: King Bed Private Bathroom with Shower*Weddings are not allowed at this home. If this policy is violated, you may be asked to vacate the property and forfeit any rental payments, and be subject to HOA, community, and 360 Blue fines.*Snowbirds are welcome!
